purpose: Teach: はずす/淋しい/逢い/ぐったり/たいがい/楽々/あわせる/あたえ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ヘッドフォンはずすか何かしろよ
lines.en: Riku, take off those headphones or something, will you?
lines.style: Sharp, familiar jab. Fast clip at the opening. No real heat — the tone of someone who's been interrupted and is teasing back. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、転校してたら淋しい事もあったろ、桜
lines.en: You transferred schools too — you must've felt lonely sometimes, didn't you?
lines.style: Quieter shift. Thoughtful, almost careful with the question. Sits with it a moment. Softer than his usual cool — a small window opening. Not quite meeting her eyes.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、好きな人に逢いたいんだろ?
lines.en: So you want to see the person you like, huh?
lines.style: Slight smirk in the voice. Knowing lilt at the end — she's caught something he didn't mean to show. Quick, playful. A jab that lands because it's true.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、徹夜明けでぐったりしてんな、桜
lines.en: You look completely wiped out from pulling an all-nighter, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry observation. Not quite a question. Slow and steady — turning her own perceptiveness back on her. Gentle mockery under the surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、たいがいの問題は解けるよな
lines.en: You can solve most problems that come your way, can't you?
lines.style: Genuine acknowledgement underneath the flatness. Steady pace. Not exaggerating — just stating what he sees. A small admission of respect.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト楽々通過したろ、桜
lines.en: You passed that test easily, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Warm, straightforward. Light conviction on the past tense. Still cool on the surface but the recognition is real. A small, real compliment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、俺に時間をあわせるな
lines.en: Don't adjust your schedule just to match mine.
lines.style: Quick, deflecting. A half-protest wrapped in sarcasm. Softer underneath — he doesn't want her to sacrifice things for him. Tests the words carefully.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、後輩にアドバイスあたえてんな、桜
lines.en: You're giving advice to the younger students, aren't you?
lines.style: Warm admiration, kept low-key. Slow enough to let it land. Fondness in the observation. Not quite praise — something closer and more real.
